candidate.scope: Assigned upper row under DNA-Protein Interactions: a grouped ChIP-family schematic ending at extracted DNA. The left representative chromatin icon is descriptive. The lower DNase-Seq / DNaseI-Seq row is a separate neighboring assay, with no connection to the assigned route. No sequencing-ready adapters, amplification or sequencing operations are drawn. Method-specific interpretation is distinguished from the literal drawn route; the four labels do not imply identical implementations. The graph preserves the literal five-operation drawing and adds only paper-supported local counterparts needed to distinguish incompatible input histories and ChIP-exo ordering. These counterpart routes are explanatory resolutions, not extra alternatives drawn by Illumina. The left representative icon/caption (Chromatin immune precipitation (ChIP-Seq), High-throughput chromatin immunoprecipitation (HT-ChIP)) is not an upstream processing branch. Yellow lines there emphasize a DNA-associated region; yellow/orange symbols in the digestion panel are not chemically defined end groups. No drawn mixing, split or link to the DNase row is asserted.
